description: This file implements an OpenAI language model (LLM) service with context aggregation support, including classes for managing context pairs, creating context aggregators, and handling function call states and image frames within the context of OpenAI's API.

classes.name: OpenAIContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: A deprecated class representing a pair of OpenAI context aggregators for user and assistant messages.

classes.name: OpenAILLMService
classes.description: A class implementing the OpenAI LLM service with context aggregation support, extending the base OpenAI LLM service.

classes.name: OpenAIUserContextAggregator
classes.description: An OpenAI-specific user context aggregator, inheriting from the generic LLMUserContextAggregator.

classes.name: OpenAIAssistantContextAggregator
classes.description: An OpenAI-specific assistant context aggregator, handling function call progress, results, cancellations, and image frames.

methods.name: user
methods.description: Returns the user context aggregator instance.

methods.name: assistant
methods.description: Returns the assistant context aggregator instance.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the OpenAILLMService with model and parameters.

methods.name: create_context_aggregator
methods.description: Creates a pair of OpenAI-specific context aggregators for user and assistant messages.

methods.name: handle_function_call_in_progress
methods.description: Handles a function call in progress by adding a message with IN_PROGRESS status.

methods.name: handle_function_call_result
methods.description: Handles the result of a function call, updating the context accordingly.

methods.name: handle_function_call_cancel
methods.description: Handles a cancelled function call, marking it as CANCELLED.

methods.name: _update_function_call_result
methods.description: Updates the message content for a specific function call in the context.

methods.name: handle_user_image_frame
methods.description: Handles a user image frame, marking the function call as completed and adding the image to the context.
